versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן מַחְלְקוֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃

controles.web: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
controles.kjv: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
controles.livre: Também os filhos de Arão tiveram suas repartições. Os filhos de Arão: Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨מָת נָדָ֤ב וַאֲבִיהוּא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַֽיְכַהֲנ֔וּ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃

controles.web: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
controles.kjv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
controles.livre: Mas Nadabe, e Abiú morreram antes que seu pai, e não tiveram filhos: Eleazar e Itamar tiveram o sacerdócio.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּֽחָלְקֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וְצָדוֹק֙ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וַאֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י אִיתָמָ֑ר לִפְקֻדָּתָ֖ם בַּעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃

controles.web: David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
controles.kjv: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
controles.livre: E Davi os repartiu, sendo Zadoque dos filhos de Eleazar, e Aimeleque dos filhos de Itamar, por seus turnos em seu ministério.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּמָּצְא֣וּ בְֽנֵי־אֶלְעָזָ֡ר רַבִּ֞ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִן־בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר וַֽיַּחְלְק֑וּם לִבְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֜ר רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־אָבוֹת֙ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר וְלִבְנֵ֧י אִיתָמָ֛ר לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם שְׁמוֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
controles.kjv: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Eleazar foram achados, quanto a seus principais varões, muitos mais que os filhos de Itamar; e repartiram-nos assim: Dos filhos de Eleazar havia dezesseis cabeças de famílias paternas; e dos filhos de Itamar pelas famílias de seus pais, oito.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּחְלְק֥וּם בְּגוֹרָל֖וֹת אֵ֣לֶּה עִם־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּי־הָי֤וּ שָֽׂרֵי־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וּבִבְנֵ֥י אִיתָמָֽר׃ס

controles.web: Thus were they divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
controles.kjv: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
controles.livre: Repartiram-nos, pois, por sorte os uns com os outros: porque dos filhos de Eleazar e dos filhos de Itamar havia príncipes do santuário, e príncipes da casa de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֡ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָה֩ בֶן־נְתַנְאֵ֨ל הַסּוֹפֵ֜ר מִן־הַלֵּוִ֗י לִפְנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ וְצָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וַאֲחִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם בֵּֽית־אָ֣ב אֶחָ֗ד אָחֻז֙ לְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְאָחֻ֥ז׀ אָחֻ֖ז לְאִיתָמָֽר׃פ

controles.web: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
controles.kjv: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
controles.livre: E Semaías escriba, filho de Natanael, dos levitas, escreveu-os diante do rei e dos príncipes, e diante de Zadoque o sacerdote, e de Aimeleque filho de Abiatar, e dos príncipes das famílias dos sacerdotes e levitas; e inscreviam uma família a Eleazar, e a Itamar outra.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֤ל הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ לִיה֣וֹיָרִ֔יב לִֽידַעְיָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

controles.web: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
controles.kjv: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
controles.livre: E a primeira sorte saiu por Jeoiaribe, a segunda por Jedaías;

versos.hebraico: לְחָרִם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִשְׂעֹרִ֖ים הָרְבִעִֽי׃

controles.web: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
controles.kjv: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
controles.livre: A terceira por Harim, a quarta por Seorim;

versos.hebraico: לְמַלְכִּיָּה֙ הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י לְמִיָּמִ֖ן הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃

controles.web: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
controles.kjv: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
controles.livre: A quinta por Malquias, a sexta por Miamim;

versos.hebraico: לְהַקּוֹץ֙ הַשְּׁבִעִ֔י לַאֲבִיָּ֖ה הַשְּׁמִינִֽי׃

controles.web: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
controles.kjv: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
controles.livre: A sétiam por Coz, a oitava por Abias;

versos.hebraico: לְיֵשׁ֨וּעַ֙ הַתְּשִׁעִ֔י לִשְׁכַנְיָ֖הוּ הָעֲשִׂרִֽי׃

controles.web: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
controles.kjv: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
controles.livre: A nona por Jesua, a décima por Secanias;

versos.hebraico: לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ר לְיָקִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
controles.kjv: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
controles.livre: A décima primeira por Eliasibe, a décima segunda por Jaquim;

versos.hebraico: לְחֻפָּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְיֶֽשֶׁבְאָ֖ב אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
controles.kjv: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
controles.livre: A décima terceira por Hupá, a décima quarta por Jesebeabe;

versos.hebraico: לְבִלְגָּה֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְאִמֵּ֖ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
controles.kjv: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
controles.livre: A décima quinta por Bilga, a décima sexta por Imer;

versos.hebraico: לְחֵזִיר֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְהַפִּצֵּ֖ץ שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
controles.kjv: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
controles.livre: A décima sétima por Hezir, a décima outiva por Hapises;

versos.hebraico: לִֽפְתַחְיָה֙ תִּשְׁעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לִֽיחֶזְקֵ֖אל הָעֶשְׂרִֽים׃

controles.web: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
controles.kjv: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
controles.livre: A décima nona por Petaías, a vigésima por Jeezquel;

versos.hebraico: לְיָכִין֙ אֶחָ֣ד וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְגָמ֖וּל שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃

controles.web: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
controles.kjv: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
controles.livre: A vigésima primeira por Jaquim, a vigésima segunda por Gamul;

versos.hebraico: לִדְלָיָ֨הוּ֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְמַֽעַזְיָ֖הוּ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃פ

controles.web: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
controles.kjv: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
controles.livre: A vigésima terceira por Delaías, a vigésima quarta por Maazias.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֞ם לַעֲבֹדָתָ֗ם לָב֤וֹא לְבֵית־יְהוָה֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔הוּ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
controles.kjv: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
controles.livre: Estes foram contados em seu ministério, para que entrassem na casa do SENHOR, conforme a sua ordenança, sob o mando de Arão seu pai, da maneira que lhe havia mandado o SENHOR o Deus de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י הַנּוֹתָרִ֑ים לִבְנֵ֤י עַמְרָם֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל לִבְנֵ֥י שׁוּבָאֵ֖ל יֶחְדְּיָֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
controles.kjv: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Levi que restaram: Subael, dos filhos de Anrão; e dos filhos de Subael, Jedias.

versos.hebraico: לִרְחַבְיָ֑הוּ לִבְנֵ֣י רְחַבְיָ֔הוּ הָרֹ֖אשׁ יִשִּׁיָּֽה׃

controles.web: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
controles.kjv: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Reabias, Issias o principal.

versos.hebraico: לַיִּצְהָרִ֣י שְׁלֹמ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י שְׁלֹמ֖וֹת יָֽחַת׃

controles.web: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
controles.kjv: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
controles.livre: Dos izaritas, Selomote; e filho de Selomote, Jaate.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנָ֖י יְרִיָּ֑הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Hebrom; Jerias o primeiro, o segundo Amarias, o terceiro Jaaziel, o quarto Jecameão.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֤י עֻזִּיאֵל֙ מִיכָ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י מִיכָ֖ה שמור׃

controles.web: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
controles.livre: Filho de Uziel, Mica; e filho de Mica, Samir.

versos.hebraico: אֲחִ֤י מִיכָה֙ יִשִּׁיָּ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה זְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃

controles.web: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
controles.kjv: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
controles.livre: Irmão de Mica, Issias; e filho de Issias, Zacarias.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲזִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah: Beno.
controles.kjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Merari: Mali e Musi; filho de Jaazias, Beno.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְיַֽעֲזִיָּ֣הֽוּ בְנ֔וֹ וְשֹׁ֥הַם וְזַכּ֖וּר וְעִבְרִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
controles.kjv: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Merari por Jaazias: Beno, e Soão, Zacur e Ibri.

versos.hebraico: לְמַחְלִי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בָּנִֽים׃

controles.web: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
controles.kjv: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
controles.livre: E de Mali, Eleazar, o qual não teve filhos.

versos.hebraico: לְקִ֖ישׁ בְּנֵי־קִ֥ישׁ יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Of Kish; the sons of Kish: Jerahmeel.
controles.kjv: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
controles.livre: Filho de Quis, Jerameel.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֔י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֖דֶר וִירִימ֑וֹת אֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
controles.kjv: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Musi: Mali, Éder e Jeremote. Estes foram os filhos dos levitas conforme às casas de suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּפִּילוּ֩ גַם־הֵ֨ם גּוֹרָל֜וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת׀ אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹ֗ן לִפְנֵ֨י דָוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְצָד֣וֹק וַאֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם אָב֣וֹת הָרֹ֔אשׁ לְעֻמַּ֖ת אָחִ֥יו הַקָּטָֽן׃ס

controles.web: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
controles.kjv: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
controles.livre: Estes também lançaram sortes, como seus irmãos os filhos de Arão, diante do rei Davi, e de Zadoque e de Aimeleque, e dos príncipes das famílias dos sacerdotes e levitas: o principal dos pais igualmente que o menor de seus irmãos.
